B0_venue_history.description: Historical sold_out rate at this venue
B0_venue_history.note: Minimum bar — does anything beat the venue's base rate?

B1_film_metadata.note: Can standard film features predict sold_out?

B2_qloo_affinity.note: Does Qloo's cultural signal alone predict outcomes?

B3_current_ranker.note: Does the current weighted score predict outcomes?

B4_qloo_plus_metadata.note: Does Qloo add value beyond metadata?

sold_out_binary.rationale: Imbalanced classes — most screenings not sold out

ranking.rationale: We care about top-K ranking quality

temporal_split.description: Train on earlier dates, test on later dates
temporal_split.rule: No future information in training set

venue_grouping.rule: Venue-level effects don't leak across splits

film_leakage.description: Same film can appear in train and test (different screenings)
film_leakage.rule: But Qloo features must be from prediction-time, not future

qloo_temporal.description: Use only Qloo data available at screening time
qloo_temporal.rule: No future Qloo popularity or affinity

minimum_observations.threshold: Not a fixed number — assess based on variance

target_variance.note: If <5% sold out, too rare. If >50%, too common.

venue_diversity.description: Multiple venues to avoid venue-specific bias

temporal_coverage.description: Enough time to capture seasonal effects

benchmark_schema.imdb_id: string — IMDB ID if available (NULL if not)
benchmark_schema.qloo_entity_id: string — Qloo entity ID if resolved (NULL if not)
benchmark_schema.tickets_sold: int — actual tickets sold (NULL if unavailable)
benchmark_schema.sold_out: bool — venue reported sold out (NULL if not observed)
benchmark_schema.qloo_affinity: float — Qloo affinity at prediction time (NULL if unavailable)
benchmark_schema.qloo_popularity: float — Qloo popularity at prediction time (NULL if unavailable)
benchmark_schema.qloo_evidence_score: float — Adjacent evidence score (NULL if unavailable)
benchmark_schema.recommendation_rank: int — Adjacent rank (NULL if not recommended)
benchmark_schema.provenance: string — how this record was obtained

status: DESIGN_ONLY — no real data to evaluate yet
